description: SYNTHETIC: multi-step time arithmetic; normalized exact answer on the ANSWER line.

messages.content: A train leaves at 09:40. It travels 210 km at 84 km/h, waits 15 minutes at a station, then travels 96 km at 64 km/h. At what time does it arrive? Think step by step, then finish with a line 'ANSWER: HH:MM'.
